title: Maximum Number of Matching Indices After Right Shifts
description:
You are given two integer arrays, `nums1` and `nums2`, of the same length.

An index `i` is considered **matching** if `nums1[i] == nums2[i]`.

Return the **maximum** number of **matching** indices after performing any number of **right shifts** on `nums1`.

A **right shift** is defined as shifting the element at index `i` to index `(i + 1) % n`, for all indices.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Maximum Number of Matching Indices After Right Shifts.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
